topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Well now, Goran came running through the fields, his face all lit up like the morning sun after a long rain. "Did you hear, did you hear?" he kept shouting. I thought the barn had caught fire or the lord's taxes had miraculously turned to dust. Turns out, it was all about Elsie. She’s been telling everyone she works in the lord's castle, spinning tales of fine clothes and rich foods. But Goran saw her himself, just a mishap in the village mill all along. It’s a grand jest, isn’t it? I bet she’ll have some red to her cheeks when the truth spreads. But no hard feelings, I reckon. We all spin our yarns, and the sun still rises no matter what.
